blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala’s path to a title in the Singapore Open requires the Filipino sensation to go through some familiar challenges. Eala is scheduled to make her debut in the Singapore Open main draw on Wednesday in the round of 16 against the winner between Belgium’s Sofia Costoulas and Russia’s Tatiana Prozorova in a first-round match set on Monday. Prozorova rallied past Costoulas, 4-6, 6-4, 6-4, in their most recent meeting last January in the Philippine Open quarterfinal. The 21-year-old Eala earned a first-round bye in the WTA 500 event as the No. 3 seed. READ: Alex Eala gets first-round bye in […]...
